name: Vehicle-Oriented Benchmark for SDG 9
description: Minimal dataset and reproducibility materials supporting an equal-budget comparison of Transit Search Optimisation and Particle Swarm Optimisation for BLDC PI speed control under uncertainty. The deposit includes 40 locked-scenario results, 30-seed optimiser evidence, post-hoc equivalence and objective-weight sensitivity analyses, and a 12-scenario phase-resolved MATLAB/Simulink R2026a confirmation. The study is simulation-only and contains no human or confidential data.
